name: Glucozone Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About GLUCOZONE TABLET

GLUCOZONE TABLET is a combination of Diacerein, Glucosamine, and Methyl Sulfonyl Methane which belongs to the group of medicines called proteoglycan synthesis stimulators and nutritional supplements, respectively. It is used in the management of osteoarthritis. Osteoarthritis is a condition that causes pain, swelling, and stiffness in the joints of the hands, knees, hips, and spine.

In osteoarthritis, the cartilage between the bones in the joint breaks down, which in turn causes the affected bones to slowly get bigger. The joint cartilage often breaks down because of mechanical stress or biochemical changes within the body, causing the bone underneath to fail.

GLUCOZONE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems. Before taking GLUCOZONE TABLET, inform your doctor if you have suffered from impaired glucose tolerance, kidney problems, heart disease, or asthma. GLUCOZONE TABLET is generally not recommended for use among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding.

GLUCOZONE TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (18 years and below). GLUCOZONE TABLET is to be taken with caution by elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking GLUCOZONE TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, constipation, indigestion, heartburn, and urine discoloration. Ask your doctor for advice if any of these side effects worsen or don’t improve.
usesDetails:
Uses Of GLUCOZONE TABLET
To manage osteoarthritis
mechanismOfAction:
How GLUCOZONE TABLET Works

GLUCOZONE TABLET is a combination of Diacerein, Glucosamine, and Methyl Sulfonyl Methane. Diacerein and glucosamine are proteoglycan synthesis stimulators that facilitate the formation of cartilage, which is an important structural component of the body. Methyl Sulfonyl Methane is a nutritional supplement that functions by lessening pain and swelling by reducing inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use GLUCOZONE TABLET

Take GLUCOZONE TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with enough water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration of GLUCOZONE TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About KONDRO FLEX SACHET

Kondro Flex Sugar Free Sachet help slow down the progression of osteoarthritis (OA) and may also be able to positively alter the structural and functional deterioration of the cartilage in the joints that occurs naturally as we get older. For patients with OA, taking a daily sachet will help regenerate cartilage and increase flexibility and mobility.

Those who are at a high risk of developing OA may also frequently take this sachet as a preventative measure. It contains collagen peptide, glucosamine sulphate and vitamin C as an active ingredient which help to maintain a healthy cartilage.

Collagen peptide gives the cartilage strength and protects its elastic properties, allowing the joints to move freely. Glucosamine sulphate is very important for the proper functioning, structure and formation of cartilage. The joint cartilages naturally contain glucosamine. As we become older, our bodies produce less glucosamine, which affects the regular regeneration of our cartilage and vitamin C is a powerful antioxidant that manages cartilage from degrading and helps in the formation of collagen fibers and mucopolysaccharides in the cartilage tissue.

Always take Kondro Flex Sugar Free Sachet as advised by the physician. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Empty the powder from the sachet into a glass and add 100ml of water into it. Stir thoroughly until the powder is dissolved completely in the water and drink immediately.

introduction:
Introduction About GLUCOZONE CG

GLUCOZONE CG is a dietary supplement has beneficial effects in preserving joint health, reducing pain, increases BMD (bone mineral density) in elderly with osteoporosis, strengthens muscles increasing their health. It contains Ascorbic acid, Collagen peptidase and Glucosamine as active ingredients.

Collagen helps in the regeneration of cartilage and provide strength to the bones and improve joint flexibility. Glucosamine is essential for new cartilage synthesis and joint lubrication. Vitamin C acts as an antioxidant that can help with iron absorption, synthesis of new collagen fibres, and promote healing at the joint site.

Take GLUCOZONE CG as advised by your physician. Take one GLUCOZONE CG daily with water or milk for at least 30 days and can continue as long as for 6 months safely. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. Do not take if you are allergic to any of its ingredients.

DYCERIN 50MG CAPSULE contains Diacerein which belongs to the group of medicines called Anthraquinones. It is used for the symptomatic management of functional symptoms of osteoarthritis.

Osteoarthritis is a common progressive disorder affecting primarily weight bearing joints (knee, hip), characterised by progressive destruction of cartilage causing pain, limitation of motion, stiffness, deformity and disability.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition like liver disease.

Avoid taking alcohol with DYCERIN 50MG CAPSULE as it may increase the risk of liver damage. DYCERIN 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having liver or kidney disease, colitis or crohn’s disease, partial or complete intestinal obstruction or abdominal pain with an unknown cause.

Inform your doctor, if you have kidney or urinary problems, history of diarrhea, irritable bowel disease, rare hereditary diseases such as congenital galactosemia, glucose or galactose malabsorption syndrome or lactase deficiency.

DYCERIN 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Contact your doctor before taking.

DYCERIN 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 15 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

DYCERIN 50MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly aged above 65 years. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking DYCERIN 50MG CAPSULE are diarrhea, soft stools, pain in abdomen, frequent bowel movements, flatulence, skin rash, itching, and eczema. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Used for the symptomatic management of Osteoarthritis
usesDetails:
Uses Of DYCERIN 50MG CAPSULE
Used for the symptomatic management of Osteoarthritis
mechanismOfAction:
How DYCERIN 50MG CAPSULE Works

DYCERIN 50MG CAPSULE works by blocking the chemicals (interleukin-1) causing inflammation and destruction of cartilage in the body. It also stimulates the production of certain chemicals called transforming growth factor-β (TGF-β) which triggers chondrocyte proliferation and stimulates the production of collagen and proteoglycan, glycosaminoglycans and hyaluronic acid. Therefore DYCERIN 50MG CAPSULE manages the cartilage destruction and improves symptoms in patients with osteoarthritis.
usageDetails:
How to use DYCERIN 50MG CAPSULE

Take DYCERIN 50MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicines with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About GLUCOZONE C2 TABLET

GLUCOZONE C2 Tablet is used to improve joint health, increase mobility, and flexibility of joints . It is indicated for tendonitis, promoting cartilage growth in osteoarthritis and rheumatoid arthritis. GLUCOZONE C2 Tablet contains Glucosamine Sulfate, Methyl sulfonyl methane, Collagen peptide type 2, Sodium hyaluronate, Vitamin C, and Vitamin D3 as active ingredients.

Glucosamine sulfate helps to slow down the rate of cartilage degeneration and relieves the symptoms of pain in osteoarthritis. MSM reduces inflammation, manages cartilage breakdown and in turn helps to reduce pain in joints and muscles. Collagen type 2 peptide maintains the integrity of cartilage. Vitamin D3 helps to improve bone development and maintains healthier and strong bones. Vitamin C helps in new blood vessel formations and to improve connective tissue density and thickness of tendon fibers. Sodium hyaluronate offers maximum tensile strength. It promotes free glide of tendons over bones while healing.

Always take GLUCOZONE C2 Tablet exactly as advised by your doctor. Swallow GLUCOZONE C2 Tablet with a glass of water. It is advised to take 1 tablet twice daily for 1-6 months or as directed by your physician. Do not exceed the stated recommended dosages.

Introduction About HILIN GM TABLET

HILIN GM TABLET contains a combination of Diacerein and Gucosamine sulfate potassium chloride which belongs to the group of medicines called Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs). It is used to manage osteoarthritis of the knee.

Osteoarthritis is a type of joint degeneration that occurs when the protective cartilage that cushions the ends of the bones wears down over time and generates symptoms such as stiffness, pain in movement, tenderness, swelling, bone spurs, crackling sound while walking. 

Before taking HILIN GM TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, heart, intestine, abdominal disease, asthma, or suffer from impaired glucose tolerance, or severe issues with the joints. Avoid consumption of alcohol during this management as it can increase liver damage.

The most common side effects of taking HILIN GM TABLET are diarrhea, abdominal pain, flatulence, headache, and nausea. Consult your doctor if symptoms do not show improvement.

Introduction About DURAJOINT GM NEW TABLET

DURAJOINT GM NEW TABLET is a combination of Diacerein, Glucosamine, and Methyl Sulfonyl Methane which belongs to the group of medicines called proteoglycan synthesis stimulators and nutritional supplements, respectively. It is used in the management of osteoarthritis. Osteoarthritis is a condition that causes pain, swelling, and stiffness in the joints of the hands, knees, hips, and spine.

In osteoarthritis, the cartilage between the bones in the joint breaks down, which in turn causes the affected bones to slowly get bigger. The joint cartilage often breaks down because of mechanical stress or biochemical changes within the body, causing the bone underneath to fail.

DURAJOINT GM NEW TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems. Before taking DURAJOINT GM NEW TABLET, inform your doctor if you have suffered from impaired glucose tolerance, kidney problems, heart disease, or asthma. DURAJOINT GM NEW TABLET is generally not recommended for use among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding.

DURAJOINT GM NEW TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (18 years and below). DURAJOINT GM NEW TABLET is to be taken with caution by elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking DURAJOINT GM NEW TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, constipation, indigestion, heartburn, and urine discoloration. Ask your doctor for advice if any of these side effects worsen or don’t improve.

ORCERIN 50MG CAPSULE contains Diacerein which belongs to the group of medicines called Anthraquinones. It is used for the symptomatic management of functional symptoms of osteoarthritis.

Osteoarthritis is a common progressive disorder affecting primarily weight bearing joints (knee, hip), characterised by progressive destruction of cartilage causing pain, limitation of motion, stiffness, deformity and disability.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition like liver disease.

Avoid taking alcohol with ORCERIN 50MG CAPSULE as it may increase the risk of liver damage. ORCERIN 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having liver or kidney disease, colitis or crohn’s disease, partial or complete intestinal obstruction or abdominal pain with an unknown cause.

How ORCERIN 50MG CAPSULE Works

ORCERIN 50MG CAPSULE works by blocking the chemicals (interleukin-1) causing inflammation and destruction of cartilage in the body. Therefore ORCERIN 50MG CAPSULE manages the cartilage destruction and improves symptoms in patients with osteoarthritis.

Introduction About HILIN 50MG CAPSULE

HILIN 50MG CAPSULE contains Diacerein which belongs to the group of medicines called Anthraquinones. It is used for the symptomatic management of functional symptoms of osteoarthritis.

Osteoarthritis is a common progressive disorder affecting primarily weight bearing joints (knee, hip), characterised by progressive destruction of cartilage causing pain, limitation of motion, stiffness, deformity and disability.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take several blood tests to understand your existing condition like liver disease.

Avoid taking alcohol with HILIN 50MG CAPSULE as it may increase the risk of liver damage. HILIN 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having liver or kidney disease, colitis or crohn’s disease, partial or complete intestinal obstruction or abdominal pain with an unknown cause.

Inform your doctor, if you have kidney or urinary problems, history of diarrhea, irritable bowel disease, rare hereditary diseases such as congenital galactosemia, glucose or galactose malabsorption syndrome or lactase deficiency.

HILIN 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Contact your doctor before taking.

HILIN 50MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 15 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

HILIN 50MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly aged above 65 years. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking HILIN 50MG CAPSULE are diarrhea, soft stools, pain in abdomen, frequent bowel movements, flatulence, skin rash, itching, and eczema. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How HILIN 50MG CAPSULE Works

HILIN 50MG CAPSULE works by blocking the chemicals (interleukin-1) causing inflammation and destruction of cartilage in the body. It also stimulates the production of certain chemicals called transforming growth factor-β (TGF-β) which triggers chondrocyte proliferation and stimulates the production of collagen and proteoglycan, glycosaminoglycans and hyaluronic acid. Therefore HILIN 50MG CAPSULE manages the cartilage destruction and improves symptoms in patients with osteoarthritis.

In osteoarthritis, the cartilage between the bones in the joint breaks down, which in turn causes the affected bones to slowly get bigger. The joint cartilage often breaks down because of mechanical stress or biochemical changes within the body, causing the bone underneath to fail.

CARTIGEN DN TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems. CARTIGEN DN TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (18 years and below). CARTIGEN DN TABLET is to be taken with caution by elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking CARTIGEN DN TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, constipation, indigestion, heartburn, and urine discoloration. Introduction About ATJOINT TABLET

ATJOINT TABLET is a combination of Diacerein, Glucosamine, and Methyl Sulfonyl Methane which belongs to the group of medicines called proteoglycan synthesis stimulators and nutritional supplements, respectively. It is used in the management of osteoarthritis. Osteoarthritis is a condition that causes pain, swelling, and stiffness in the joints of the hands, knees, hips, and spine.

In osteoarthritis, the cartilage between the bones in the joint breaks down, which in turn causes the affected bones to slowly get bigger. The joint cartilage often breaks down because of mechanical stress or biochemical changes within the body, causing the bone underneath to fail.

ATJOINT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems. Before taking ATJOINT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have suffered from impaired glucose tolerance, kidney problems, heart disease, or asthma. ATJOINT TABLET is generally not recommended for use among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding.

ATJOINT TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (18 years and below). ATJOINT TABLET is to be taken with caution by elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking ATJOINT TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, constipation, indigestion, heartburn, and urine discoloration. Ask your doctor for advice if any of these side effects worsen or don’t improve.

ETODY TH TABLET is a combination of Etoricoxib and Thiocolchicoside which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) and Muscle relaxants. It is used to reduce pain and swelling in the joints and muscles in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, gout and muscle spasm. This medicine is also used for the short-term management after dental surgery for moderate pain. Muscle spasm is the rapid spontaneous contractions of the muscle, which can be painful and uncomfortable. When the nerve impulses are damaged or interrupted that control muscle movement, it could lead to muscle spasms. Symptoms include muscle tightness, joint stiffness, unusual posture, difficulty in moving and pain in affected muscles and joints.

ETODY TH TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having inflammatory bowel disease, severe congestive heart failure, peptic ulcer or cerebrovascular disease. Consult your doctor for advice. How DYCERIN A TABLET Works

DYCERIN A TABLET is used to reduce pain and swelling, where aceclofenac acts as an anti-inflammatory agent and painkiller thus blocks the production of inflammatory mediators called prostaglandins in the body which are responsible for causing pain and swelling at the site of injury. As a result, it reduces the joint pain and swelling. Diacerein works by blocking the actions of a protein called interleukin-1β and cytokines which are involved in inflammation and degeneration of tissues thus relieves inflammation and damage of tissues.

Introduction About GEMTIDE 750MCG INJECTION

GEMTIDE 750MCG INJECTION is used in both men and postmenopausal women with Osteoporosis who are at high risk for having fractures. It contains Teriparatide which belongs to the group of medicines called Anabolic agents. GEMTIDE 750MCG INJECTION works by causing the body to build new bone by increasing bone strength and bone mass density (BMD) (thickness) and reduce the risk of fractures by stimulating bone formation.

It also increases the thickness of bone and rebuilds bones which reduces the risk of spine and hip fractures. GEMTIDE 750MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women. GEMTIDE 750MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with Paget’s disease, bone cancer or other cancers, certain bone diseases and hypercalcemia.

The most common side effects of GEMTIDE 750MCG INJECTION are dizziness, leg cramps, mild headache, tachycardia, hypercalcemia symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, constipation, low energy, or muscle weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsens or persists for a longer duration.

introduction:
Introduction About RECARTIX PLUS TABLET

RECARTIX PLUS TABLET is a combination of Diacerein, Glucosamine, and Methyl Sulfonyl Methane which belongs to the group of medicines called proteoglycan synthesis stimulators and nutritional supplements, respectively. It is used in the management of osteoarthritis. Osteoarthritis is a condition that causes pain, swelling, and stiffness in the joints of the hands, knees, hips, and spine.

In osteoarthritis, the cartilage between the bones in the joint breaks down, which in turn causes the affected bones to slowly get bigger. The joint cartilage often breaks down because of mechanical stress or biochemical changes within the body, causing the bone underneath to fail.

RECARTIX PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver problems. Before taking RECARTIX PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have suffered from impaired glucose tolerance, kidney problems, heart disease, or asthma. RECARTIX PLUS TABLET is generally not recommended for use among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding.

RECARTIX PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (18 years and below). RECARTIX PLUS TABLET is to be taken with caution by elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking RECARTIX PLUS TABLET are nausea, diarrhea, constipation, indigestion, heartburn, and urine discoloration. Ask your doctor for advice if any of these side effects worsen or don’t improve.
